input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder, so long as such
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use covenant on Client, so it sits at the preferred position. § 2(a) (p0022/p0024) does the opposite of a restrictive covenant: it expressly confirms Client is not obligated to use the License and "is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink," subject only to non-infringement of TrueLink IP and Section 10 confidentiality — both standard IP/confidentiality carve-backs rather than business restrictions. The words "in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables" in § 2(a) define the scope of the licence granted to us, not a covenant limiting the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build. § 8 (Client covenants) contains only compliance, notification, access-limitation, anti-spam and content warranties — no covenant not to compete. The single reference to a "Non-Competition Agreement" in § 8(d) (p0054) operates as a limitation on TrueLink's licence to use Credit Data and therefore benefits us; it is an undefined cross-reference to a separate document, which we would diligence for any restriction binding Client, but nothing in this Agreement restricts us. No redline required.
